title: Personal Certificate Expiry Watch
dataSources: Breach alerts (`breach:alert`), inbox stats (`inbox:stats`), cloud-drive usage (`clouddrive:usage`), certificate expiry (`certexpiry:check`).
app: Personal cybersecurity feeds — Have-I-Been-Pwned breach alerts, personal email/inbox stats, cloud-storage usage APIs, and personal TLS-certificate expiry checks — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=certexpiry:check
| eval days_left=round((expiry_epoch-now())/86400,0)
| where days_left<21
| sort days_left
| table host days_left issuer
description: Watches the TLS certificates on your home-lab services and domains and warns before any expires.
value: An expired certificate breaks your self-hosted services and looks alarming; an early warning avoids the scramble.
implementation: Probe your certificates into `index=personal`; alert on those expiring soon.
visualization: Table of certificates by days until expiry.
grandmaExplanation: It warns you before the security certificates on your home services expire, so nothing suddenly breaks.
